messages.body: We agreed that Atlas will combine relationship notes, project history, and cited source messages in one calm workspace.

messages.subject: Atlas prototype review
messages.body: The prototype needs stronger citation placement and a clearer distinction between generated text and user edits.

messages.subject: Atlas beta scope
messages.body: The beta scope is now dashboard, people, projects, newsletters, and concepts, with no chronological inbox view.

messages.subject: Archive resilience sprint
messages.body: The first recovery drill restored the local database and verified that source message IDs remained stable.

messages.subject: Re: Archive resilience sprint

messages.subject: Archive resilience closeout
messages.body: We closed the sprint after documenting restore steps and testing the read-only archive boundary.
